gh pr create --head pi/issue-57-hide-default-tools --base main --title "ci: offer the model only pit's typescript tool in pi-assistant" --body "Closes #57.

Follow-up to https://github.com/cv/pi-action/pull/56#issuecomment-6820877249. Adds \`model_tools_hidden: read, write, edit, bash\` to the \`Run pi-action\` step of \`pi-assistant.yml\`.

This uses \`model_tools_hidden\` instead of \`exclude_tools\`. \`exclude_tools\` would turn the coding tools off completely, and pit's programs could no longer reach them through \`tools.*\`. With this change the model gets only \`typescript\`, and the \`🤖\` log line should read \`tools: typescript\`.

The dogfood workflows (\`pi-direct-dogfood.yml\`, \`pi-pr-review-dogfood.yml\`) don't load pit, so they keep the default tools."
